data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (proposed cap 0.25 s for regen and timers)

best_idea: Gate a special on endurance at use time, make it wait out an activation delay, spend the cost once at fire time, then block re-use for a recharge time, with every countdown and regen step scaled by the measured frame time.
decision_why: Take the gate, activation, recharge and toggle-upkeep shape for Frankendom specials, with cost, delay and recharge as catalogue fields (row 21), and fix the donor's silent endurance clamp (re-check at fire, report shortfall) and its uncapped frame delta in the sketch; the donor has no endurance discount and only one general defence value, so neither is claimed.
acceptance: A server test uses a special costing 25 endurance at 20 endurance and asserts it is refused with no state change; at 30 endurance it queues, fires once after its activation time with endurance down to 5, and a second use is refused until the recharge time has passed.
